issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (shared across all saloons), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (non-static). This contradicts the specification and may confuse students about whether the method should be static and how it should access the shared stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the specification: declare calculateTotalPrice as a static method (public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) so it uses the shared static stock, or alternatively update the problem description to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice be static. Prefer changing the implementation to a static method to preserve the educational intent about shared stock management.
